contexts.text: To be instructed about heavenly and Divine things from sensuous ones, is as impossible as...
(To receive these truths after the man has confirmed himself against them) is impossible. Explained.
To see such things from an inverted state is impossible...
That it is an impossibility if a change is not made. Signified.

And everything which is contrary to Divine truth, being contrary to order, is impossible... Hence it is impossible that he who has lived well should be sent into Hell, and that he who has lived evilly should be elevated into Heaven: consequently, it is impossible that they who are in Hell can... be saved... (This) is impossible, because it is contrary to order; that is, to the Divine which is order.
(Thus) it is impossible to compel a man to salvation.
To take such things away is impossible, because it is contrary to order.
From these examples it is evident that all that is impossible which is contrary to order.

If they are told that... Hell cannot be turned into Heaven with a man, and that this is impossible, because contrary to order, and therefore to truth Divine, thus contrary to God Himself, who is order...
It is impossible for any material idea to enter Heaven...
To know one's own reigning love is impossible to those who are in the love of self...
A faith in impossible things is not given; that is, a faith in such things as the man thinks to be impossible.
Therefore, to think otherwise about God is impossible to the Angels.
To believe and think that all evil and falsity are from Hell appears impossible...
To take any (theological truth) from any other source than the Lord, is as impossible as it is to sail from England... to the Pleiades...
To work redemption without the Human, was as impossible for God, as...
To approach Jehovah the Father in His own light, is as impossible as...
As it is impossible for God to condemn anyone who lives well, and believes rightly; so, on the other hand, it is impossible for God to save anyone who lives evilly, and thence believes falsities...
That the imputation of the merit and justice of Christ is impossible. General article.
From their natural mind... before which nothing but impossibilities are objected.
Then... the impossibilities disappeared.
I maintained that it was impossible...
I told them that it was impossible for them to come into the sphere of the Angels... SE 3466.
In proportion as anyone's love is held back, which takes place through various causes which are called things impossible... it does not act.
To believe in a Divine... which cannot be thought of under any shape, is impossible.
